test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) S = N 4 & % L A * 6 T & C @ 4 B % 2 X L (Right)

How many such numbers are there which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given series:

N 4 & % L A * 6 T & C @ 4 B % 2 X L

Condition to be checked:

Numbers which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a symbol.

**Letter → Number → Symbol**

__**N 4 &**__ % L A * 6 T & C @ 4 B % 2 X L

Thus there is one such pattern (N 4 &) that is following the above conditions.

Hence, **"1"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

Immediately preceded by means immediately before or to come just before.

Immediately followed by means immediately after or to come just after.
